scope: Mapped-core structural linkage, native I/O transport and separate IO-only ring. Not a core-integrated physical padframe, final timing, scan/ATPG, complete PHY or manufacturing acceptance.

native-release/result.json.scope:
Exercise the chip shell with native IHP IO models and a pin-stimulus core.

This is an IO wiring/serial-status test, not execution of the real CPU or PHY,
and not electrical, ESD, timing or physical padframe qualification.

link-audit.json.scope: Exact retained mapped-core cells/ports and top-level connections. No complete chip simulation, electrical, CDC timing, physical routing or manufacturing acceptance.

floorplan-spaced/result.json.scope:
Place native IHP IO cells, corners and fillers in a provisional 4.0 x 3.2 mm ring.

No core, serial logic, signal routing, seal ring or accepted package is included.
Checks cover LEF footprints and abstract TopMetal1 power-rail abutment only.

ring-contact-check/result.json.scope: Native main-rule DRC on IO-only ring, no core, signal routing, bond-pad/passivation/seal-ring completion, density, antenna, LVS or product acceptance.

tests.scope: Chip I/O, prepared lint and documentation-link tests
